$comment: Test vectors of the work pack of a plan round over a feature folder (epoch 3 E3 s3 t3). Each vector is {name, covers, files, scope, order, dependencies | refused}: `files` maps a path inside the feature folder to its text; `scope` is the scope folder from the feature folder (empty is the whole feature); `order` is the feature-relative path of every file section in pack order; `dependencies` is the outside-dependency lines (node, title) in pack order; `refused` is a word the refusal sentence holds. A file value may be {prefix, line, times}. Server only (AWorkPackIsTopologicalTests).
